exposure: interventions for mildly impaired glucose tolerance (IGT) / gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: Pregnant women with mild IGT who delivered a singleton at 22 weeks of gestation or later, categorized into an untreated group (2000-2009, n=503) and a treated group (2011-2017, n=781).
finding: The incidence of GDM-related composite complications was comparable between the untreated and treated groups, although infant birth weights were lower in the treated group.
